scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test:packages
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:public
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:package && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const targets=['node_modules'];const root='packages';if(fs.existsSync(root)){for(const name of fs.readdirSync(root)){targets.push(path.join(root,name,'dist'));targets.push(path.join(root,name,'node_modules'));}}for(const target of targets){fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});}"
